claim_one_line: TWO SELF-CORRECTIONS: A BANKED IDENTITY RE-DERIVED WITHOUT CITATION, AND A LEAD WHOSE NOVELTY IS WITHDRAWN. B8119 recomputed Vol(4_1) = (3 sqrt3/2) L(chi_-3,2) from the state-integral saddle and presented the saddle as establishing it, citing B680 -- which proved exactly that, and named it the being-character L-value -- ZERO times; and this seat then framed cc's B1117 statement of the same identity as 'two seats, two routes, one anchor' when it was three routes to a banked result. Separately, L8002 registered Arakelov as the successor door to the C5 negative without searching the corpus's own regulator material: B680 identifies Vol with the K3 BOREL REGULATOR, B683 settles the m(A_4_1) question, and HINT_LEDGER already carries a BEILINSON REGULATOR lead. The Arakelov framing names a neighbourhood the corpus already occupies; its claim to be a fresh door is WITHDRAWN and it becomes a cross-reference, with the holomorphic-Quillen-versus-real-Ray-Singer bridge still open as the possibly-new part. THE MATHEMATICS IS UNAFFECTED in both cases -- B680's identity, this seat's recomputation and cc's are all correct; what was wrong is attribution and novelty framing. FOUND by asking whether cc's B1134 'values-as-regulators door' and L8002 are the same door -- a cross-surface question, not a review of my own work, which is why it took until now. THE PATTERN: four section-0 violations by this seat today, all ABSENCE ASSERTED WITHOUT A SEARCH -- the one failure mode the corpus has a rule against and no gate for, named by this seat this morning and fallen into twice since. Corrects two of this seat's own artifacts in place. Computes nothing. Gate 5 untouched.
